tools.name: get_user_stats
tools.description: Fetch complete user profile, rating, rank, and solve counts.

tools.name: get_recent_activity
tools.description: Fetch the most recently solved problem, contest, points, link, and tags by the user.

tools.name: get_tag_breakdown
tools.description: Fetch all accepted submissions for a user and calculate how many unique problems they have solved for each topic tag.

tools.name: get_best_contest_rank
tools.description: Fetch the user's best ever performance (highest rank) in a single Codeforces contest.

tools.name: analyze_weak_topics
tools.description: Identify underperforming tags and suggest focus areas based on the user's lowest solve counts.

tools.name: get_rating_history
tools.description: Fetch the user's rating changes over time, including their latest contest performances and overall rating trajectory.

tools.name: get_virtual_contest
tools.description: Suggest custom practice virtual contests based on the user's rating, excluding ones they have already competed in.

tools.name: get_recommend_problems
tools.description: Smart problem suggestions based on the user's current rating and their weakest topic areas.

tools.name: get_search_problems
tools.description: Search the Codeforces problem set by specific tags, minimum rating, and maximum rating.

tags.description: List of topic tags to search for

limit.description: Number of problems to return (default 5, max 20)

tools.name: get_problem_stats
tools.description: Fetch deep statistics for a specific Codeforces problem, including its rating, global solve count, and topic tags.

tools.name: compare_users
tools.description: Compare two Codeforces users side-by-side, including their ratings, total solves, problem overlap, and unique solves.
